items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: And my grandpa, George Robinson, well, he named Jim Crow. And he said, well, I'm going to make a difference between other Jims. I'll call him Jim Little.

ctx.x: Well, how did you get the name Jim? What's the name? How did they get the name of Jim? How did you get the name of Jim? Well, I don't know.

I don't know how I got the name of Jim, but I was in two different houses, you know. Because I used to live with my mother and my stepdad. And Jim was with his, my grandmother was dead. Jim would live with his other sister and her husband, see. And my grandpa, George Robinson, well, he named Jim Crow. And he said, well, I'm going to make a difference between other Jims. I'll call him Jim Little. Yeah. That's how that was. And, well, that's about the best I can do for you, Bill.

One more short question about your string bass. Did you have any lessons on that? Where did you learn to play it as well as you do? You play it so fine and that wonderful tone and the good rhythm style.
